name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) are both hard and match the ordered command, and together they force door_open, which the task commands. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches the 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' preference, and key_lost already encodes the closed-door condition. Blocker and key prerequisites are guaranteed by the environment constraints and are not stated by the task, so they need no clause.

texts: Take the mission's target box (target_picked_up), the last step of the ordered sequence.
Open the door (door_open) before taking the target box.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed (key_lost should not occur).
